sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied san-isidro-schools.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site, not an asserted capture URL. Affine independent check errors: 1.06 m, 8.34 m. Does not meet the 5 m registration gate; conservative source-constrained estimates only. One shared rotated reference; western high-school roof and elementary school's lower classroom chain checked independently. Separate parents and packs remain. The first lower-left elementary corner match used the wrong roof end. Added its visible northeast end as a distributed fit control and checked the neighboring lower roof and excluded NHS southeast corner. Imagery-to-OSM disagreements are clipped to complete mapped obstacles; no surveyed boundary, species, court markings, construction date or exact inventory inferred. No bitmap ships. Only supported interior links are authored; a complete source-clear frontage-to-building/pitch link could not be established from this reference. The approach gate remains unmet.
